# Architecture Governance

Read AGENTS.md and the master architecture before any structural change.

Checks:
1. Identify affected layer and owner.
2. Verify dependency direction.
3. Verify no parallel security authority.
4. Verify tenant and data ownership.
5. Determine whether an ADR is mandatory.
6. Produce machine-checkable acceptance criteria.

Never approve architecture from prose alone; require repository evidence.
